notes.semetey-2-2013:p0003:b004:l002: Жолум үй is rendered as a house broad as a millstone, following the established epic size formula; the exact image is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0003:b004:l024: The line says forty-two nobles carry Karagul out to urinate, an intentionally degrading image preserved directly.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0003:b004:l025: Кысыр эмди тай is rendered as a barren, milk-fed foal; the precise livestock category is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0003:b004:l026: Казы and жал are rendered as horse-rib fat and mane fat, traditional horse-meat delicacies.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0003:b006:l001: Күпсөр is retained as küpsör in the mixed-liquor phrase because the exact vessel, ingredient, or drink type is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0003:b006:l027: Абыгый is retained as Abygyi, Karagul's form of address or title; its exact status is uncertain.
